long: The Typing of the Dead: Overkill is a typing-based rail shooter built on the grindhouse-styled The House of the Dead: Overkill. Players type the words displayed over enemies to kill them as the camera moves on rails through B-movie horror levels. It supports local two-player co-op and was published by Sega.
name: The Typing of the Dead: Overkill
